_comment: Texture classes and the objects belonging to each, for `ros2 run polyumi_ros2 texture_collect`.
Copy this file, replace the classes and objects with yours, and pass it as -p config:=<path>.
Names become directory and file names, so they must be [A-Za-z0-9_-] only.
Several objects per class is the point: a class learned from one object is a model of that
object, and nothing in the data would show the difference. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
